header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Endure Hardships and difficulties when Giving Da'wah towards Allaah

blocks.text: Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) took his waterbag and provisions along with him to the Masjidul Haraam and spent the day there. However, when evening arrived, he had not yet seen Rasulullaah ﷺ. He had returned to the place where he intended to lie down when Hadhrat Ali (RA) passed by and said, "Has the man not yet found his destination?" Hadhrat Ali (RA) then helped him up and took him home without any of them exchanging questions. When things turned out the same on the third day and Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) again stayed with Hadhrat Ali (RA), Hadhrat Ali (RA) asked, "Will you not tell me what brings you here?" Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) replied, "I shall inform you if you give me your word that you would give me proper direction." When Hadhrat Ali (RA) agreed, Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) informed him. Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "It is true that he is the Rasul of Allaah. Follow me closely tomorrow morning. If I see anything that may jeopardise your safety, I shall stop with the pretence of needing to relieve myself (but you should proceed). When I continue walking, you should follow me once more and enter the place I enter. Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) did this and followed in the footsteps of Hadhrat Ali (RA) until Hadhrat Ali (RA) came to Rasulullaah ﷺ and Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) entered with him.

Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) listened to Rasulullaah ﷺ and accepted Islaam on the spot. Rasulullaah ﷺ said to him, "Return to your people and convey the message to them until I send further instructions." Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) said, "I swear by the Being Who controls my life that I shall shout it aloud amongst them all!" He then proceeded to the Masjidul Haraam where he called out at the top of his voice:

blocks.arabic_text: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَّسُوْلُ اللّٰهِ
blocks.text: "I testify that there is none worthy of worship but Allaah and that Muhammad ﷺ is Allaah's Rasul."

The Mushrikeen then beat him to the ground. Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) arrived and threw himself over Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) (to shield him) saying, "Fools! Don't you realise that he belongs to the Ghifaar tribe and that your traders have to pass them on the route they use to Shaam?!" In this manner, Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) saved him. The following day, Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) repeated himself. The Mushrikeen again assaulted him and Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) had to throw himself over him (to save him).[^1]

Another narration of Bukhari states that Hadhrat Abu Dharr (RA) announced, "O assembly of Quraysh! I testify that there is none worthy of worship but Allaah and that Muhammad ﷺ is Allaah's servant and Rasul." The Mushrikeen shouted, "Get that heretic!" They then beat him up with the intention of killing him when Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) arrived and threw himself over him. Turning to the people, Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) said, "Fools!
